name: Unelma Email Verification with SnapValid
author: unelmaplatforms

sections.description:
Unelma Email Verification integrates SnapValid’s powerful API into your WordPress site to provide real-time email validation across forms, checkout, and user registration.

Improve your data quality, reduce spam, and increase conversions — all without sending a single email.

Why Choose SnapValid?

  • ✅ Real-time email validation
  • ✅ Prevent fake signups instantly
  • ✅ WooCommerce & Contact Form 7 support
  • ✅ GDPR compliant (no data stored)
  • ✅ Zero email sending (no blacklist risk)
  • ✅ Fast & lightweight

Perfect For

  • 🛒 WooCommerce stores
  • 📝 Contact forms
  • 👤 User registrations
  • 📩 Newsletter signups
  • 📊 Lead generation forms

Supported Integrations

E-Commerce

  • WooCommerce checkout validation

Forms

  • Contact Form 7
  • Custom forms (via WordPress validation hooks)

WordPress Core

  • User registration
  • Comments (optional extension)

Key Features

🔍 Email Validation

  • Syntax validation (RFC compliant)
  • Domain & MX record checks
  • Disposable email detection
  • Invalid email blocking

⚡ Real-Time Feedback

  • Instant validation using AJAX
  • User-friendly error messages
  • No page reload required

🛡️ Spam Protection

  • Block fake & temporary emails
  • Prevent low-quality signups
  • Improve database quality

📊 Admin Features

  • API key settings page
  • Simple integration setup
  • Lightweight and fast
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/unelma-email-verification-snapvalid
  2. Activate the plugin through WordPress admin
  3. Go to SnapValid Settings
  4. Enter your API key
  5. Done ✅
sections.faq:
How does this WordPress plugin work?

The plugin connects to the SnapValid API and validates email addresses in real time during form submission, checkout, or registration. It checks syntax, domain, and deliverability without sending any emails.

Does email validation affect my IP reputation?

No. SnapValid does not send emails. It only verifies email validity via secure API, so your IP reputation remains completely safe.

Does this plugin store email addresses?

No. The plugin does not store or save any email data. All validation happens in real-time via API.

Is this plugin GDPR compliant?

Yes. Since no personal data is stored and validation is done securely, the plugin is fully GDPR compliant.

How much does it cost?

You can start with free validation credits. Additional usage may require a paid SnapValid plan depending on your needs.

What happens when I run out of credits?

If your credits are exhausted, validation will stop temporarily or fallback to basic validation. You can upgrade your plan to continue using full validation features.

Can I get a refund if I’m not satisfied?

Please refer to SnapValid’s official refund policy. Typically, unused credits or subscription issues are handled by their support team.

How fast is the validation?

Validation happens in real-time (milliseconds), providing instant feedback to users without slowing down your website.

What’s the accuracy rate?

SnapValid provides highly accurate validation using advanced checks like DNS, SMTP, and disposable email detection.

Does it work on mobile devices?

Yes. The validation works seamlessly across all devices including mobile, tablet, and desktop.

Which forms are supported?

The plugin supports:
– WooCommerce checkout
– Contact Form 7
– WordPress registration
– Custom forms using standard validation hooks

Do I need coding knowledge?

No. Simply install the plugin, enter your API key, and it works automatically.

What if I need help?

You can get support via:
– WordPress support forum
– Plugin support page
– SnapValid support team
